## Recovery Limitation

No separate original Stage A `SCOPE_BRIEF.md`, internal dossier, or author
packet was recovered in committed branch history or the surviving package
workspace. The frozen owner register records the admitted scope decisions and
questions, but this consolidation does not reconstruct missing process files
from memory or thread history. [`SCOPE_BRIEF.md`](SCOPE_BRIEF.md) is therefore
an explicit recovered scope-control note, not a claim that the original Stage
A file was found.

Implementation, schema, audit, repair, validation, Unity, and production
materials are excluded from scientific authorship and from this recovery.
